checks.name: 총보수 0.5% 이하 값 보유 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) > 0 AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) <= 0.5

checks.name: 총보수 0.1% 이하 값 보유 ETF
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) > 0 AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) <= 0.1 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE), pd_itm_no

checks.name: 순자산 5,000억 이상 상장중 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) >= 500000000000

checks.name: 2025년 상장 상장중 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND replace(coalesce(pd_lstg_dt,''),'-','') BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231'

checks.name: TIGER 200 기준가
checks.sql: SELECT TRY_CAST(du_last_nav AS DOUBLE) FROM kr_etp WHERE pd_itm_no='KR7102110004'

checks.name: 정식명 '주식' 표기 ETF 총보수 하위 3
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND pd_nm ILIKE '%주식%' AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) > 0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE), pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: Total Return 표기 ETF 순자산 상위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND pd_nm ILIKE '%Total%Return%' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 5

checks.name: 상품명 '일본' 표기 상장중 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (pd_nm ILIKE '%일본%' OR pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%일본%')

checks.name: 미래에셋 순자산 1조 초과 상장중 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp e LEFT JOIN mgmt_resolved m USING (pd_itm_no) WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND coalesce(m.resolved, e.cu_fund_mgmt_co) LIKE '미래에셋%' AND TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) > 1000000000000

checks.name: 해외 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM global_etf WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF'

checks.name: 퇴직연금 편입 가능 ETF 순자산 상위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_listing_status='active' AND upper(coalesce(pd_pen_tr_yn,''))='Y' AND drv_instrument_type='ETF' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 5

checks.name: 상장일 오름차순 상위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND nullif(pd_lstg_dt,'') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY replace(pd_lstg_dt,'-','') ASC, pd_itm_no LIMIT 5

checks.name: 판단 범위 밖 명시
terms: 위험 여부의 판단은 제공 범위 밖

checks.name: '글로벌' 표기 ETF 총보수 하위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (pd_nm ILIKE '%글로벌%' OR pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%글로벌%') AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) > 0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE), pd_itm_no LIMIT 2
